source_document: NBA 2026-27 Regular Season Schedule By Date (PDF)
source_document_header: Column header prints 'LOCAL | ET' for the two tip-time columns; the document is dated 'as of August 13, 2026' and marked SUBJECT TO CHANGE
extraction_tool: fetch_page (PDF to markdown), chunks 1 and 2 of 13

window.reason: rest and back-to-back state for the 11/16-11/18 slate needs the days before the window; four lookback dates (11/13-11/15) plus the three slate dates cover a 4-in-6 and 3-in-4 check with no missing prior date inside the lookback

extraction_notes: Rows 34-42 (11/13), 231-235 (11/14) and 236-259 (11/15-11/17) print the two team cells with no separate 'at' cell; rows 260-269 (11/18) print an explicit 'at'. The away/home order for the shared dates is therefore taken from printed order and corroborated against the NBA.com games-page slug and the official injury report's AWAY@HOME code, never inferred.
Only the printed date is used for the rest arithmetic. A date is a fact on the document; a tip time is not needed to count games in a window.
This file is a rest-input observation. It contains no model output, price, line or pick.
